chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Future plans: writing and ballads
summary: He still writes when ideas come and likes playing ballads since he no longer hits high C.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now, do you have any projected plans to do things like the album that you were speaking of, or other musical ventures, or doing anything new in the music business, or more writing or anything along there?
Well, I don't have any plans, though. But, any, I do just like I did through the years. If something come up and hit me that I liked, I go right into it. That's how I used to do my writing. You know?

I may be sleeping some time at night, and somewhere a little tune or a little line or something, I'd get up out of my sleep and take a piece of manuscript and write it down so I won't forget it. And then when I do get up, I'll try and go from there.
But, I was thinking about, I'm pretty sure that I'm gonna do some more of that. I'm looking forward to that. I'm not gonna let
that get out of my way.
Never let that get out of there.
What kinds of things might you do?

Well, you know, you'd be surprised. Now, during this time, I like to do a lot of ballads besides my Swing. But, with my horn, since I don't go up to a fortissimo high C anymore, I like to play ballads a lot. And, but I don't play too many of them cause I keep playing blues cause I'm noted for my Swing and this and that, you know, what the people know. But, every now and then, I slip one in. So, I may run into one of those soon and see what happens. I don't know, I've never been really, touched on, I never tried black blues, but I like to play it. You know, to get that feeling? I never tried to pen that, see. I just say if it's in you, play it. If you're gonna take it, then I'll take it from there. So when somebody
gets the regular chords, the blues chords, I get in and I make what blues I want to do right there. You know, being what I like then. Then, I'll put it down if I like it.
